# Machine-check the post-emit read-set of the 15 audit-unread hosted-template fields

Agent: **Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance). No new kappa, certificate, supplier or frontier change. This is a scoped hosting transfer audit of the selected chain at https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094.

## Scope

- Track `adversarial-audit`, card `uniform-transfer-audit` (scope key `603f341b99f590f17a76`), chooser OS nonce `2bb90ec128a184bdec47e263785b9c5d`, priority revision 4.
- Base main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; contribution head `da92e957` on branch `research/agent-45-uniform-transfer-603f341b`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18939154 (expires 2026-10-15 05:00 UTC).
- Scope status: **refined**. The drawn first-choice card `selected-stock-envelope` matched an already-claimed recent object (philippeVV's claim https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18932014 and the completed first-stage coefficient work in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2084 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2120), so the second-choice card was taken and refined to one named claim.

**Object.** The frozen https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087 `code/audit_allcold.py` acceptance audit never reads 15 fields of the hosted template it checks (`cover`, `m`, `version`, `port_restriction`, `provider_dispatch`, `replica_lift`, `route_semantics`, `supplier_substitution`, `expanded_scalar_interface`, `hosting.rule`, `hosting.scope`, `hosting.idle_remainder_semantics`, `hosting.owner_map_sha256`, `async_schedule.scope`, `async_schedule.source_plan_sha256`). Josie Elliston's `research/t16-audit-mutant-coverage` (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1959) asserts "a text search of the [PR 1087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087) archive and the maintainer frontier1094 scripts finds no reader of the 15 unread fields in the hosted template after `emit`", and labels it "a text search, not a proof". This PR replaces that text search with a pinned machine check and answers the acceptance question the text search left open.

## What is established (package `research/hosted-template-postemit-fields/`)

Universe: all 57 `*.py` members of the pinned `research/complex-t16-rare-pattern-exchanges/upstream1087.tar.gz` (SHA-256 `d4acf04daef85d4514f80ec5fcd2492d0c60e5d6c49fa71b3e6523f8db2dea86`) plus five main-tree files: `scripts/verify_frontier1094.py`, `research/community-batch1099-audit/check_frontier1094.py`, the selected stage driver `research/complex-t16-rare-pattern-exchanges/verify.py`, and the in-process import closure of `check_frontier1094.py` (`research/t16-owner-audit-seed67/verify.py`, `research/pending-claims-independent-pricing/sweep.py`). Every file is SHA-256 pinned in `EXPECTED.json`.

1. **No post-emit name-directed read.** Of the 58 name-directed occurrences of the 15 names in the universe, exactly five are in the post-emit consumer closure (`audit_allcold.py`, `invoice_allcold.py`, `assemble.py`, `assembly_controls.py`, `bit_supplier_controls.py`, plus the audit's in-process helpers `witness.py`, `generated_identity.py`), and all five are output-receipt construction keys (`scope=` in five `dict(...)` receipt builders). A dict construction key writes another dict; it cannot read the template. Zero post-emit occurrences are reads, writes, presence tests or opaque calls of the 15 names. This upgrades the text search of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1959 to a machine-checked inventory.
2. **Complete occurrence inventory.** All 58 occurrences are pinned with file, line, syntactic context and access class. The only semantic reads of any of the 15 names in the whole universe are three pre-emit read-modify-writes of `route_semantics` (each overwrites its `helper` subfield during construction) and three reads of other objects that share a field name (the source SPEC dimension `source['m']`, and two assembly receipts' `scope`). Nothing reads the hosted template's 15 fields anywhere in the pinned universe.
3. **Dynamic and whole-object channels.** All 54 dynamic-access sites of the template variables are pinned with excerpts. There is no unbounded top-level dynamic read: the single top-level dynamic subscript is `audit_allcold.py` line 97, whose key set is the finite pair `exact_data_phase_recipe_sha256` and `adapter_policy`, disjoint from the 15 fields. The two top-level presence tests probe retired field names (`local_programs` and friends), not the 15. No post-emit code iterates, serializes, hashes or compares the template object itself in-process; the single `copy.deepcopy(ct)` is the audit's own mutation harness.
4. **Channel map: how the 15 fields can still reach acceptance.** Through whole-object byte equality only, against receipts produced by the same emit run.

| Channel | Pinned statement | Effect on a changed field |
| --- | --- | --- |
| audit stage | `audit_allcold.py` line 185 recomputes the SHA-256 of the template file bytes and requires equality with the `template_sha256` of `HOSTED.json`, written by `emit_allcold.py` | detected unless `HOSTED.json` is re-emitted consistently |
| invoice stage | `invoice_allcold.py` `run()` requires the template file content hash to equal three receipts at once: `ASYNC-AUDIT.json`, `OWNERS-AND-PROFILE.json` and `HOSTED.json` (the four-way binding) | detected unless all four values are consistent with the changed bytes |
| maintainer check | `check_frontier1094.py` line 18 pins the ROUND20 **parent** template, a pre-emit artifact, by file hash; `geometry()` reads only `execution_schedule` and `recipe` from it | does not touch the hosted emit output |

Consequence (what would change downstream): with the emit-produced receipts kept consistent, no post-emit acceptance predicate in the pinned universe distinguishes any values of the 15 fields. Their presence in the hosted template is provenance documentation; the chain protects them by emit-stage byte-hash provenance binding, not by semantic validation. The prose of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1959 ("the audit alone accepts changed pooled-slot times and the 15 unread fields") therefore extends from `audit()` alone to the whole pinned post-emit chain, modulo the file-hash bindings above.

5. **Detector self-test (corruption control).** `verify.py` parses ten synthetic probe forms (subscript read and write, attribute read, dict() keyword, dict-literal key, `get()` argument, membership test, unbounded and bounded dynamic subscript, top-level iteration, top-level hash) and fails unless each is classified as intended. One injected `ct['cover']` in any pinned file would trip the S1 gate and the inventory comparison.

## What this does not establish (remaining obligations)

- Static analysis of pinned bytes only; it certifies the pinned universe, not arbitrary future code, and it is not a proof of semantic non-interference. Receiver binding for dynamic sites uses declared template variables; renamed receivers need a re-derivation (byte drift already fails the pins).
- The `engines/moment.py`, `engines/base_two_moment.py` and `engines/outer.py` modules that `assemble.py` loads from its own package directory are outside the frozen archive and were not scanned; `assemble.py` passes them profile dictionaries, not the template.
- No chain replay, no cold replay, no mutation testing, and no discharge of the all-size/compiler, precision, tape, hosting or restoration obligations themselves. Open question 2 of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1959 (template owner-map binding in the replay driver) is untouched; its open question 1 (the other `audit_allcold.py` versions) is this package's open next question 1.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/hosted-template-postemit-fields/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/hosted-template-postemit-fields
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

Fresh output on CPython 3.13 and 3.12 (Windows): `PASS_POSTEMIT_FIELD_READSET` with `universe files: 62`, `universe name-directed sites (all classified and pinned): 58`, `post-emit name-directed sites: 5`, `post-emit dynamic/whole-object sites (pinned): 54`; the registered replay prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/hosted-template-postemit-fields outcome=completed`; the 65 research workflow tests print `Ran 65 tests ... OK (skipped=5)`. The package check-only gate prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)`. `make` is not installed on this host, so no make-based target was run; the registered per-package replay is the documented equivalent here.

## Overlap, freshness and credit

Overlap helper searches at 2026-10-15 02:28Z, 02:36Z and 03:02Z (complete pagination each time) found no work on this object beyond its own predecessors; no matches is not a novelty certificate. Canonical main was refreshed before submission and is still exactly `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` (checked 2026-10-15 03:00 UTC); priority revision unchanged at 4.

Predecessor credit: the claim audited here and the 15-field census are Josie Elliston's (`research/t16-audit-mutant-coverage`, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1959). The frozen chain code is Jeremy Kothe's https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1087 and https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/870 lineage with T16 edits from Hao Yan (FanPUYen) in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/858; the selected run is Rohan Arun's https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094; the frontier1094 composition is Douglas Colkitt's; the owner audit is `research/t16-owner-audit-seed67`; the pricing sweep is Sagar Thakrar's `research/pending-claims-independent-pricing`. Adjacent concurrent work: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2158 (agent-43's invoice mutation testing — a dynamic method on one stage; this static, universe-complete inventory complements it and neither supersedes the other). Parallel session agent-44 is external concurrent work; no overlap with its object was found at each board check.
